run_calculate_snr_cli: run the calculate_snr.py CLI on a WAV file list to compute SNR values in parallel
calculate_snr_function: calculate the signal-to-noise ratio of an audio sample using VAD thresholds and windowing
convert_wav_buf_f32: convert a WAV buffer from int16 or int32 dtype to normalized float32 audio data
calculate_file_snr: calculate the SNR for a single WAV file by reading its audio and corresponding VAD file
mp_file_snr: process a list of WAV files in parallel to compute SNR with optional resume support
